newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares recover at end of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares recover at end of settlement.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse closed higher on Friday, the last day of the settlement period, as foreign investors made selective purchases and speculators covered short positions, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 3.12 points higher at 775.70. It had dipped 3.16 points to 769.42 after the first 30 minutes of trade.

"Short covering on account of the end of the fortnightly settlement in the late part of the session mainly contributed to the recovery in stock prices," said Manoj Aggarwal of brokers Multiple Investments.
State Bank of India gained 8.75 rupees at 306.75.
Hindustan Lever fell five rupees to 995 on profit-taking.
